posts.title: "Projects" is a new harness pattern, and it is very effective.
posts.description: Claude and Cursor now have a "Projects" feature, with a few key attributes: You primarily talk to one coordinator thread, which manages other threads to do the actual work. The coordinator and all the worker threads run on their own cloud machines There is a shared filesystem mounted on every machine, where notes, rules, status, etc. can be shared between threads.
